findings.summary: The advisor has not been released to production. Coordinator deployed M1/M2 stop at HTTP 307 before credentials are sent; independent unauthenticated GETs on both documented production origins also redirect /asesor/login and /api/asesor/login to /login. Local live success cannot establish production R1-R13 acceptance.

Required production phone acceptance has no completed observations. The M2 release record still marks camera/gallery, microphone, denied permissions and recovery, keyboard, reload, original media, approval/admin and provider retry observations pending. No physical-phone review was executed in T15; these checks remain unaccepted after any release.

The T7 findings checker still cannot enforce the declared T15 audit contract. The first exact command defaults to an absent ignored reports/e2e/asesor/integration-results.json; the explicit-results command rejects the stored evidence revision before reaching findings. Defaults also assume T7 rather than combined T14a evidence, the parser requires legacy taskReferences and closed instead of the canonical tasks/fixed contract, and the CLI edit-boundary scan defaults to reports/audit rather than the complete worktree. Positional arguments, the results alias and Git fallback already exist; changing source or fabricating passing integration evidence is outside this audit.

The supplied acceptance evidence does not demonstrate the full live conversation evaluation matrix or production R9/R10 behavior. Local M1 exercises twelve directions and selection, but neither its recorded checks nor M2 establish themed items, standard-package-first matching and sourced price, daily refresh/fallback under failure, or live contact/address refusal and prompt-injection scenarios. Deterministic gate success does not fill these live evidence gaps.

The delivered customer UI cannot send a photo. useConversation hard-codes capabilities.photo=false, ChatView supplies no onPhoto callback, and Composer disables its photo button. No advisor file input or upload callback is connected to the page. The M2 HTTP scenario uploads directly to the API, so its local PASS does not establish camera/gallery behavior required by R7.

Direction/package results are not connected to the customer UI. useConversation always returns an empty cards array and ignores tool-result and final-state offers; ChatView renders message content as text only, with no direction photos or package price card. Composer has optional card presentation but receives no cards. HTTP assertions for offers and selection therefore do not establish R9 photo directions or the T13 customer package/price card.

Required production phone acceptance has no completed observations. Deployed HTTP M1/M2 evidence does not observe physical-phone login, keyboard, camera/gallery/microphone permissions, denied-permission recovery, original media display, same-device reload, summary/approval/admin interaction or provider retry. These checks remain unaccepted. David (owner) is the required phone actor; T7/T10 own collection of the release acceptance evidence.

The T7 findings checker cannot enforce the declared T15 contract in a clean snapshot. Its default integration path is ignored reports/e2e/asesor/integration-results.json. Explicit results reach a parser requiring legacy taskReferences and closed, rejecting canonical tasks/fixed; defaults assume T7 and reports/audit with the wrong allowed report pair. The tracked T14a integration report pins historical revision 34a3abc1108e2337185a3c2d5721b64cce403aa2 and outcome failed, distinct from audited d4ed27424ac0c449acc032012aafc5635e5510c3 and deployed c25a5f42fc9727b84f454f166e08348521cca6ad. Existing Git fallback does not resolve those incompatibilities. T7 must repair the checker; T14a must provide current immutable integration evidence. Exact failures and scope restrictions are recorded in T15.md.

The supplied evidence does not demonstrate the complete nine-scenario real-model conversation evaluation or R9/R10 production acceptance. Deployed M1 exercises twelve directions and selection through HTTP, and M2 exercises media persistence/correction/admin, but neither establishes live themed items, standard-package-first matching and sourced price, daily refresh/fallback under failure, contact/address refusal or prompt injection. Deployed M1 also omits the optional provider-failure check. Deterministic tests do not fill these live evidence gaps.

The delivered customer UI cannot send a photo. useConversation hard-codes capabilities.photo=false, ChatView supplies no onPhoto callback, and Composer disables its photo button. No advisor camera/gallery file input or upload callback is connected to the page. Deployed M2 uploads directly to the API, so its PASS does not establish the customer flow required by R7. The audited src/packages tree matches the observed deployed release.

Direction/package results are not connected to the customer UI. useConversation always returns an empty cards array and ignores tool-result/final-state offers; ChatView renders message content as text only, without direction photos or a package price card. Composer has optional text card presentation but receives no cards. Deployed HTTP assertions for offers and selection therefore do not establish R9 photo directions or the T13 customer package/price card.

A complete approved brief correction followed by failure of the next provider round leaves no regenerated summary. An independent in-memory runAdvisorTurn reproduction against current imports emits PROVIDER_FAILURE with retryAvailable=true, retains the corrected theme and invalidates approval, but summaryVersion is null and summarySequence remains 4; asserting regenerated version 5 exits 1. Customer-fact loss is not demonstrated. T3/T14.2a must review correction-summary regeneration and recovery; the normal-path passing tests do not exercise this combination.

The customer chat does not render the persisted summary supplied in tool/final state or expose a link to the approved printable brief. useConversation keeps streamed prose and progress only, and the reload contract discards structured summary state. After propose_summary the server intentionally finishes without another provider round and can send only a short acknowledgment; ChatView displays that prose without the authoritative summary for review. R11 cannot be accepted from API approval assertions alone. The separate BriefView route exists but is not linked by ChatView.
